content.text:
Use Tailwind's arbitrary-value syntax to pass the CSS variable straight into `border-color`:

```html
<div id="test" className="border-[rgb(var(--foreground-rgb))]">
```

This matches the `border-[<value>]` pattern (`src/docs/border-color.mdx`, utilities table) — square brackets let you supply any raw CSS value, including a `var()` reference, so the border color updates dynamically with `--foreground-rgb`.
